Type: acceptance gate
Plan: docs/institutional-pilot-epics.md
Assessment: docs/institutional-readiness-plan.md
Work key: Q02
Accountable role (person unassigned): Independent reviewer and representative users
Pilot scope: required

Outcome: The institutional collaboration and interface claims have independent and human acceptance evidence.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Review and exercise current role/action boundaries, denied discovery/counts, session/grant expiry, revocation, restricted source/report leakage and selected browser-session protections.
2. Have representative curators/researchers complete import, organization, correction/conflict recovery, sharing and retrieval; resolve blocking findings.
3. Complete actual screen-reader/keyboard evidence including CON-03; record reviewer, versions, source state, outcomes and unresolved limitations. Automated checks cannot stand in for missing human results.

Review all child evidence against these integration criteria. Children closing does not automatically close this gate. Required human/institutional evidence must be observed, never inferred from automated tests.

Completion rule: satisfy every acceptance criterion with observed evidence. Failed or not-run requirements stay open. Preserve scientific identity/history and current authority; create blocking remediation work for discovered scope. Automated or simulated evidence cannot replace a required institutional or human result. No implementation is claimed by this plan.
